ops.title: daemonkit artifact cache has no GC; ~3GB retained with no eviction
ops.description: daemonkit@v0.23.0/artifact/cache.go mentions gc in comments; no implementation exists. Measured 2026-09-02: ~/.daemonkit/cache 920MB (37 digests), ~/.daemonkit/tools 2.0GB (8 retained capt-hook venvs, each carrying spacy+WordNet), ~/.daemonkit/bin 126MB. Fleet-wide — the captain-hook repo has an overlapping finding, and binrun already has a gc verb to build on. Care needed: live sessions run older versions (12.22.3 and 12.22.5 were both in use), so eviction must not pull a running artifact.

ops.text: artifact/cache.go implements gc keeping N versions per artifact name
~/.daemonkit/tools no longer retains 8 full capt-hook venvs
